QuestInfo.name: Farewell, Grandis
QuestInfo.0: You should say your farewell to Chief #bGen#k before leaving.
QuestInfo.1: You said your farewell. Return to #bFenelle#k in #bPantheon's Great Temple#k and head to the new world.
QuestInfo.2: You departed for the new world through the Interdimensional Portal.

0.msg: I stopped in to say my goodbyes before I leave. You know, I'm grateful for all you've done for me over the years... Thanks, boss.\r\n

1.msg: Hah. I didn't take you for the sentimental type. Don't get yourself killed out there, okay? Heh. It'd be a real shame if I never saw that sunny face of yours again.\r\n

2.msg: Don't get all choked up on me, Boss. I can travel back and forth through the Interdimensional Portal whenever I feel like it.\r\n

3.msg: Hah. I s'pose I'll have to make up something to tell the crew about why you're gone. Maybe I'll say you're on a special mission.\r\n

4.msg: You can tell the others whatever you want. Anyway, take care of yourself, Boss. I'll see you around.\r\n

5.msg: #b(Looks like there's nothing left to do but return to Pantheon's Great Temple.)#k\r\n

0.msg: #b(There are a lot of memories tied to this place. Feels weird to leave it now.)#k\r\n#r(You will automatically move to the relevant field.)#k
#b(Was there something else you needed to say?)#k\r\n

1.0: Have you set all your affairs in order? Then I'll explain how to reach the new world.\r\n

yes.0: You can travel to the new world through the #bInterdimensional Portal#k on the right side of the Great Temple.\r\n
yes.1: Of course, you can come back here to tidy up unfinished business any time through the #bInterdimensional Portal#k from a place called #bSix Path Crossway#k in the other world.\r\n
yes.2: Oh, and take a look at the light bulb notifier on the left side of your screen if you don't know what to do after you arrive in the new world.
yes.3: Helping other people and listening to their problems may not be second-nature to you, but it will provide you opportunities to get stronger.
